# Project Arklight

> Arklight is developing America's next generation talent. Real operators, trained on real work, with military methodology and AI, ready to ship on day one. Based in Austin, Texas.

## Main
- [Project Arklight](https://www.arklight.us/): Arklight is developing America's next generation talent.
- [Research](https://www.arklight.us/research): Original research and field notes on the American skilled-workforce gap.
- [Careers](https://www.arklight.us/careers): Open roles at Project Arklight.
- [Contact](https://www.arklight.us/contact): Investor, commercial, media, and general inquiries.
